EDGE_CASE_FOUND.title: Case-sensitive ntfs-3g mount + XP uppercase paths -> FALSE artifact_absent
EDGE_CASE_FOUND.root_cause: XP image mounted via ntfs-3g is CASE-SENSITIVE; XP uses uppercase WINDOWS\system32. Tools hardcode 'Windows/System32' -> path does not resolve -> tool returns needs_extract_windows_artifacts -> the audit-backed artifact_absent fix (6bd8259) then marks the artifact ABSENT.
EDGE_CASE_FOUND.impact: extract_prefetch (81 .pf) + extract_shimcache (XP ShimCache in SYSTEM hive) FALSELY reported artifact_absent -> their evidence was MISSED. Forensic-accuracy problem (claims 'Prefetch not present' when 81 exist). Score impact limited here (GT carried by registry+filesystem), but real.
EDGE_CASE_FOUND.relation: This is the exact degradation risk flagged when porting the artifact_absent fix (needs_extract_windows_artifacts != genuine absence). It bit on XP uppercase paths.
EDGE_CASE_FOUND.fix: Task #175 — case-insensitive path resolution for XP/older images; refine artifact_absent to distinguish path-resolution-failure from genuine OS absence.
EDGE_CASE_FOUND.fix_status: FIXED + deployed + validated, commit 03a5516 (2026-06-06): _ci_resolve case-insensitive resolver (proven on the real image — /mnt/disk/WINDOWS/Prefetch + SYSTEM hive resolve, Amcache correctly None), shimcache case-fold, 1c positive-absence guard, USN size-aware timeout, 5 regression tests pass. RE-RUN SKIPPED by operator decision: the fix is validated at the resolver level and the v1 score (86.7%) was carried by registry+filesystem, so a full re-run to recover the 81 prefetch .pf was judged unnecessary. v1 score below STANDS with the documented prefetch/shimcache false-absence caveat; the fix protects all FUTURE cases (esp. SRL). v1 backed up run_backups/HACKINGCASE_v1_falseabsence_*.

interpretation.headline: Strong 86.7% / 0 halluc on a 2004 WinXP image — validates the framework handles XP via registry+prefetch+filesystem. No gaming, sigma honestly zero (no logs), Amcache/SRUM correctly absent. Surfaced one real edge case (XP uppercase paths -> false artifact_absent on prefetch/shimcache).
interpretation.xp_verdict: Handled well enough; the 2 FNs are pcap-content + AV-scan capability gaps, and the 1 edge case (case-sensitivity) is a known fix.
